institutions.account_format: The bank's own account number (length varies by bank)
institutions.limitation_note: The bank and the PesaLink rail expose account lookup and a transaction-status query, but Konduyt has no implemented connector for this bank yet, so a Direct Connection can be connected and verified but not executed.
institutions.name: Absa Bank Kenya
institutions.obtain_instructions: Open a business account at Absa Kenya and request API access through your relationship manager.
institutions.refund_note: Konduyt does not move money. A merchant-initiated refund is a transfer from the merchant's own account; Konduyt only records it.
institutions.source: Absa Kenya participates in PesaLink; its own API access is partnership-based. PesaLink (IPSL) provides the interbank rail and a Transaction Status Query.

institutions.limitation_note: Airtel Money exposes a merchant collection API with callbacks and a transaction-status query, but Konduyt has no implemented Airtel Money connector yet, so a Direct Connection can be connected and verified but not executed.
institutions.name: Airtel Money
institutions.obtain_instructions: Get an Airtel Money merchant account from Airtel Kenya, then register on the Airtel Africa Developer Portal to obtain API credentials.
institutions.refund_note: Airtel Money offers disbursement APIs, but a merchant collection reversal is not confirmed as a self-service operation -- treat refunds as merchant-initiated until verified.
institutions.source: Airtel Africa Developer Portal (Airtel Money collections + callbacks)

institutions.account_format: 07XX XXX XXX or 2547XXXXXXXX (or a Buy Goods till number)
institutions.name: M-Pesa
institutions.obtain_instructions: Register for M-Pesa as a business (Buy Goods till or Paybill), then request Daraja API access for that shortcode on the Safaricom developer portal. Go-live is an approval step, not a config flag.
institutions.refund_note: Daraja documents a Reversal endpoint, but Konduyt's M-Pesa connector does not implement a reversal call yet, so refunds are merchant-initiated for now: the merchant refunds from their own M-Pesa account and Konduyt only records it.
institutions.source: Safaricom Daraja (M-Pesa Express / C2B, Transaction Status, Reversal)

institutions.limitation_note: T-Kash offers collections and a transaction query, but its developer documentation is not public to the standard of Daraja's and Konduyt has no T-Kash connector. Not executable.
institutions.name: T-Kash
institutions.obtain_instructions: Get a T-Kash merchant account from Telkom Kenya, then request API access for the T-Kash merchant API.
institutions.refund_note: No verified self-service reversal; refunds are merchant-initiated.
institutions.source: Telkom Kenya T-Kash merchant API (collections, transaction query) -- recorded from a third-party API directory, not verified against Telkom's own developer documentation, which is not publicly published to Daraja's standard.
